errorCodes.meaning: No vetter engine exists for this context and community.
The vetter holds no class credential under a label the parameters name as live.
The vetter holds no free token under a live label.
`applicantId` is not a valid PCS identifier.
The parameters name a suite the engine does not implement.
The community parameters cannot be decoded.

AttestMeta.description: What the vetter checked in the session, as vetting/attestation/0.1's StatementMeta states it, without the token members: the engine fills those from the token it spends.
AttestMeta.title: AttestMeta

Attestation.description: An attestation as a vetter hands it to an applicant: the payload of vetting/attestation/0.1, without its `ext`. The engine produces it from vta/pcs/attest and takes it into vta/pcs/verify-attestation.

attestation.description: The attestation: a tag, a shown class credential and a proof. It names no vetter.

suite.description: The suite the attestation was made under, as the community publishes it.

Attestation.title: Attestation

AttestationToken.description: The attestation token spent on one attestation: the label it was drawn under, the serial its spend reveals, and its re-randomised signature. The same members as `token` in vetting/attestation/0.1.

serial.description: The serial revealed by the spend.

shown.description: The re-randomised token signature, verifiable under the published token key.

AttestationToken.title: AttestationToken

CommunityParameters.description: The community's hidden-vetting parameters exactly as its join manifest publishes them, under the criterion's `vetting.ext`. The caller copies them in verbatim on every call that needs them, because the community rotates labels and the engine keeps no copy of its own: a stale copy costs the caller a refused proof, never a mistaken one.
CommunityParameters.title: CommunityParameters

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Multibase.description: A binary value, multibase base58btc over the suite's canonical encoding.
Multibase.title: Multibase

PublishedConfig.description: The parameters exactly as they now appear in this community's join manifest, under vetting.ext. What an applicant and a vetter read.

helperKey.description: The helper verification key, multibase — named for its role on the wire rather than for hvk.

tokenKey.description: The token verification key, multibase — named for its role on the wire rather than for tvk.

vetterLabels.description: Class labels published whole, e.g. vetter/2026-09 — a request names one of these, not the bare period.

PublishedConfig.title: PublishedConfig

PublishedEvent.description: The published shape drops approvedBy and graceDays: who approved is the community's own record, and a vetter is told closesAfter when its request is approved rather than being handed the raw grace period here.
PublishedEvent.title: PublishedEvent

StatementMeta.description: What a Vetting Statement would have said, minus its issuer.

cardDigestMultibase.description: Digest of that card, as the vetter verified it.

claimsVerified.description: The claim types the vetter checked.

community.description: The community this attestation is for. An attestation is not portable between communities.

declaredRelationship.description: The relationship the vetter declared, which the community's independence rules count.

identityCommitment.description: The commitment on the Vetting Card the applicant showed. Consistency across attestations is what stops two applicants pooling them.

livenessConfirmed.description: Whether the vetter confirmed a live person.

method.description: How the vetter met the applicant.

requirementsDigest.description: The digest of the criterion's requirements as the vetter read them.

tokenLabel.description: The token label spent, repeated inside the bound facts so it cannot be swapped in transit.

tokenSerial.description: The token serial spent, likewise bound.

validFrom.description: A DATE, never a timestamp: an exact time would let a community line an attestation up with a vetter's activity, which undoes the proof without touching it.

validUntil.description: A date, for the same reason.

TickLength.description: The length of one tick of the drip, as an ISO 8601 duration in days and/or hours — at least `PT1H`. A label's tick `t` is the window starting `t` tick lengths after the label's start (`vtc/vetting/vetters/pcs-tokens`).
TickLength.title: TickLength

dripPerTick.description: How many tokens a tick under this tier yields.

name.description: How the menu names it: desk, busy-desk.

schema.description: A vetter's client asks its VTA to attest, after the human check, that an applicant was vetted: the VTA spends a token and makes an attestation that names no vetter.

applicantId.description: The applicant's PCS identifier, from its vetting/request.

community.description: The community's DID: the helper whose parameters the engine runs under.

contextId.description: The context the engine belongs to. Its key is derived from this context's base.

parameters.description: The community's published hidden-vetting parameters, copied verbatim from its join manifest.

preferLabel.description: A token label to spend under in preference — an event label the vetter is attesting at.

schema.title: VTA PCS — Attest — payload
